questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

No bat is a wicket.

No wicket is a glove.

Conclusions:

(I) No bat is a glove.

(II) No wicket is a bat.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a20fa28695252f06b40f0e734fad471e728e96845b2ebcfbe143ab2881f8ac19.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) No bat is a glove → Does not follow (As no bat is a wicket and no wicket is a glove. As no direct relation is given between bat and glove, therefore it is false.)

(II) No wicket is a bat → Follow (As no bat is a wicket. As no bat can be wicket, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
5 is related to 120 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 3 is related to 24. To which of the following is 2 related following the same logic?

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is: cube of 1st number - 1st number = 2nd number.

5 : 120 ⇒ (5³ - 5) = 125 - 5 = 120

3 : 24 ⇒ (3³ - 3) = 27 - 3 = 24

Similarly,

2 ∶ ? **⇒ (2³ - 2) = 8 - 2 = 6**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some watches are belts.

Some belts are ties.

Conclusions:

(I) Some watches are ties.

(II) Some belts are watches.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusion I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8659156bf572d31f9c3e856a26cb989494e815766b2900ec6603ad89cbf0bdcc.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some watches are ties → Does not follow (As some watches are belts and some belts are ties. So it is possible but not definite.)

(II) Some belts are watches → Follow (As some watches are belts. As some part of watches is common with belts, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
U, V, W, X, Y, K and A are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order) .

Only two people live between W and X when counted from the left of X.U sits third to the left of K.V sits to the immediate right of K.V sits second to the left of W.Y is not an immediate neighbour of U.

Who sits third to the right of A?
questions.solution:
**Given: **U, V, W, X, Y, K and A are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.​

1) Only two people live between W and X when counted from the left of X.

2) V sits second to the left of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/776d2a58134c321cb5fea1711b26d39d3f613c67bbcf35752de35ae97369c925.png] 

3) V sits to the immediate right of K.

4) U sits third to the left of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5914fc94878f54b9debccab77672791e515d840edf5d0b4ddedd343250a00b6a.png] 

5) Y is not an immediate neighbour of U.

After positioning Y only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12c59708778688726f1c0fe15881745dc1d83610532fdf741b70fdbc4f314fc4.png] 

Thus, V sits third to the right of A.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
